subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should Control UI resolve this by landing a larger fixed initial history window, or should closure require explicit older-message pagination using the existing `chat.history` offset contract?
rationale: Current main proves the cap and the offset-capable backend, but docs intentionally describe bounded recent history for stability, so the UX/performance tradeoff needs maintainer intent before treating any one implementation as done.

options.title: Require bounded pagination
options.body: Keep the issue open until Control UI can load older history pages on demand while preserving the bounded initial request.

options.title: Accept larger fixed batch
options.body: Treat a coordinated request/render-cap increase as an intentional pragmatic fix after the linked PR or replacement lands with proof.

options.title: Fold into broader pagination work
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92317 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87111 as the canonical implementation direction, then resolve this paired issue/PR together.

recommendation.title: Require bounded pagination
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until Control UI can load older history pages on demand while preserving the bounded initial request.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a Control UI UX/product-shape decision and steipete has recent adjacent WebChat history work in the relevant path.
